```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
primary_net_attendance_rate <- read_xlsx("../Data/Adjusted_net_attendance_rate_2022_formatted.xlsx", sheet= "Primary", skip = 1) |>
  rename( "ISO" = `...1`,
         "Country" = `...2`,
         "Sub-Region" = `...3`,
         "Development" = `...5`,
         "Total Completion" = `...6` 
)
LowerSecondary_net_attendance_rate <- read_xlsx("../Data/Adjusted_net_attendance_rate_2022_formatted.xlsx", sheet= "Lower secondary", skip = 1) |>
  rename( "ISO" = `...1`,
         "Country" = `...2`,
         "Sub-Region" = `...3`,
         "Development" = `...5`,
         "Total Completion" = `...6` 
)
UpperSecondary_net_attendance_rate <- read_xlsx("../Data/Adjusted_net_attendance_rate_2022_formatted.xlsx", sheet= "Upper secondary", skip = 1) |>
  rename( "ISO" = `...1`,
         "Country" = `...2`,

)
```
